Question: A binary operation \(\diamond\) has the properties that \(a\diamond(b\diamond c)=(a\diamond b)\cdot c\) and that \(a\diamond a=1\) for all nonzero real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c.\) (Here the dot \(\cdot\) represents the usual multiplication operation.) The solution to the equation \(2016\diamond(6\diamond x)=100\) can be written as \(\dfrac{p}{q},\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(p+q?\)
